description: This file is a shell script used for testing cherry-pick functionality in a Git repository. It sets up test scenarios, runs Git commands, and verifies expected behaviors related to cherry-picking commits, including handling multiple commits, merge strategies, and revert operations.

methods.name: check_head_differs_from
